lines.say: blocks SGLT2, so more filtered sugar leaves in the urine
blood sugar falls in type 2 diabetes: HbA1c about 0.4 to 0.9 points below placebo
fewer cardiovascular deaths in type 2 diabetes with heart disease: 3.7% vs 5.9% on placebo
fewer cardiovascular deaths or heart failure hospital stays in heart failure
slower kidney decline in chronic kidney disease, with or without diabetes
about 2% to 3% more weight lost than placebo in diabetes (not approved for weight loss)
kidney function checked; a small early eGFR dip is expected and usually steadies
foot sores and infections watched; amputations not significantly raised across 4 trials
ketoacidosis, even when blood sugar isn't very high; ketones checked if suspected
dehydration, low blood pressure and acute kidney injury, more so in older adults
genital yeast and urinary infections; rare serious ones include Fournier's gangrene
